charts.title: 01_mild_overlay
charts.caption: Mild arm: SBP never falls below 100 on either side (infection controlled); blood pathogen peaks ~6.3 identically. The agreement case that frames the severe divergence.

charts.title: 02_mild_fluctuation
charts.caption: Even in the agreement case, the engine carries continuous physiological variation — the InfectionModerate nutrition schedule plus full homeostatic control drive SBP over an ~11 mmHg range and swing the fluid pools — while the autonomous SBML extraction (a closed ODE with no meals, respiration, or temperature inputs) sits nearly flat. Same clinical outcome, no ambient dynamics.
